evidence.note: Opening step shows only title, one timeline item, the server diagram and a legend, with wide open space around them.
Three columns (timeline, diagram, one quote card), each separated by clear gutters; at most one quote card is shown at a time and each one replaces the last.
Two concept cards blur the background, so only the cards are read at that moment, with space between and around them.
A pile of document icons covers the Package mirror node; this is busy, but it is the crash beat the step is showing.
At the small size the timeline list grows to 5 dated items plus 2 sub-bullets with tight line spacing, and reaches nearly to the bottom edge, level with the legend.
The Insight card sits alone over a blurred background with enough margin around it.

rationale: Each step adds one item, and old quotes are swapped out rather than stacked, so the slide stays calm with purposeful whitespace and the diagram at its centre. The one crowded spot is the timeline column at 1288x598 in steps 5-6, where the full list is packed tightly and runs close to the bottom edge. That fits level 4 (clean with one minor crowding) rather than level 5.
